messages.content: The chair's tilt mechanism is broken. It won't lock in any position.
That's strange - it was working perfectly when I shipped it. Have you tried the tension adjustment knob under the seat? Turn it clockwise to increase resistance.
Yes, I've tried that. The knob turns but nothing changes. The mechanism seems to be internally broken.
I understand. I have video of it working before shipping. Let me check if Herman Miller offers any repair services in your area.
I'd prefer a refund at this point. I don't want to deal with repairs on a chair I just bought.
